description: A platform-level throttle: a plain-text 429 with no Retry-After, which a client must treat as transient rather than as a quota problem.

interactions.note: non-JSON 429 with no Retry-After: transient, retry with exponential backoff plus jitter (B-066)

synthesis_note: Reconstructed from /errors/rate-limits. This response is emitted by the platform edge under load and cannot be induced by a single caller; attempting to would mean deliberately loading a live production service.
